exposure: non-medically indicated cesarean delivery on maternal request (CDMR)
cohort: 6,972 singletons born by full-term SVD and 3,626 by CDMR, extracted from a larger cohort of 17,748 liveborn infants from a randomized controlled trial in China
finding: Cesarean delivery on maternal request (CDMR), independent of medical indications, was found to be associated with increased risks of childhood obesity and anemia, but not with pneumonia or neurobehavioral disorders.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery on maternal request (CDMR) was associated with increased risks of childhood obesity and anemia compared to spontaneous vaginal delivery (SVD).
